summary.headline: Planetary Attributions Table
summary.text: Chapter Eleven explains the planets’ natures, essences, shapes, bodily attributions, masses, fardar, planetary years, motions, combustion and retrogradation intervals, and northern and southern latitudes. A comparative table gives these attributes for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
